parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the topmost part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic, small in size, and ergonomically shaped for finger pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to press down and activate the pump mechanism, dispensing liquid soap or lotion from the container.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed, returning to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head part connects the pressing lid to the pump mechanism and the base body, made of durable polyethylene plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the base body through the pump and out through the nozzle when the lid is pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but contains internal moving components that facilitate fluid flow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of transparent or semi-transparent PET plastic, cylindrical or oval in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid soap or lotion and provides structural support for the pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the reservoir for the liquid.
